response: ["When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1-3mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.", "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions and on the genitalia.", "The consensus rate for this recommendation is 100% (21/21).", "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ.", "Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.", "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor and in the same operative setting whenever possible.", "The pigment_network criterion is atypical and contributes 2 points to the checklist score.", "The dots_and_globules criterion is irregular and contributes 1 point to the checklist score.", "The streaks criterion is indeterminate, contributes 0 points, and is flagged as unresolved.", "You should look for irregularities in the pigment network, such as thickened lines and irregular meshes, on the image.", "You should look for irregularly distributed dots and globules on the image.", "The presence of these major and minor scoring elements collectively pushed the score to the threshold level."]
